text: dsh-fish-shell 是一个 DSH 服务端 shell 插件：它将模型调用的 bash 工具命令交给 Fish 执行，并在系统提示中提醒使用 Fish 语法。它替换本地执行器的前台和后台 bash 命令，也适配沙箱命令；可选配置 Babelfish 翻译独立 Bash 变量赋值。适合希望 DSH 命令使用 Fish 的用户。需要安装 Fish；Babelfish 翻译为可选配置。

dsh-fish-shell runs commands from DSH’s bash tool through Fish, including foreground, background and confined sandbox commands. An optional Babelfish path translates standalone Bash variable assignments. Fish is required; Babelfish is optional. A prompt note asks the model to use Fish syntax.
想让 DSH 的 bash 工具实际用 Fish 执行命令
让 DSH 前台和后台 shell 命令都使用 Fish
DSH 能否在沙箱里也通过 Fish 跑命令？
dsh-fish-shell 的功能「用 Fish 执行 DSH 命令」：将匹配到的本地 bash -c 命令改为 fish -c。前台、后台执行以及沙箱约束的命令均会采用配置的 Fish 路径运行。
dsh-fish-shell 的功能「可选翻译 Bash 赋值」：配置 Babelfish 路径后，检测到独立变量赋值形式的命令会先交给 Babelfish 转换，再由 Fish 执行；Fish 原生语法保持原样。

dsh-fish-shell README · do not use. it simply causes more retries due to syntax rewrites：A DeepSeek Harness (DSH) profile plugin that runs commands submitted through the model-facing `bash` tool with Fish instead:

```text
bash tool call → fish -c <command>
```

The public tool remains named `bash` so its existing schema, presentation, sandbox approval, output, timeout, and background-job contracts remain intact. The plugin adds a system-prompt note instructing the agent to use Fish-compatible syntax.
section: do not use. it simply causes more retries due to syntax rewrites

text: dsh-fish-shell README · do not use. it simply causes more retries due to syntax rewrites：It updates both foreground and background commands. When DSH mounts its sandboxing shell executor, it also changes the inner confined command from `bash -c` to `fish -c`. Persistent PTY terminal sessions are not changed.
section: do not use. it simply causes more retries due to syntax rewrites

text: dsh-fish-shell README · do not use. it simply causes more retries due to syntax rewrites：When configured with [Babelfish](https://github.com/bouk/babelfish), it preprocesses commands containing standalone Bash assignments before Fish runs them. For example, `NAME=value`, `export NAME=value`, and `NAME=$(command)` become Fish `set` commands. Fish-native commands are left unchanged. Babelfish failures stop the tool call instead of executing untranslated Bash.
section: do not use. it simply causes more retries due to syntax rewrites

text: dsh-fish-shell README · Dependency：Bash-assignment translation depends on [Babelfish](https://github.com/bouk/babelfish). It is optional: omit `babelfishPath` to run Fish directly without Bash translation.

dsh-fish-shell README · Configuration：By default, the plugin uses `$SHELL` when it ends in `/fish`; otherwise it runs `fish` from `PATH`. On this system `$SHELL` is `/opt/homebrew/bin/fish`, so the default resolves to that absolute path.

Set explicit executable paths in the profile patch if needed:

```yaml
- id: fish-shell
  config:
    fishPath: /opt/homebrew/bin/fish
    babelfishPath: /opt/homebrew/bin/babelfish

dsh-fish-shell README · Configuration：`babelfishPath` is optional. Without it, the plugin runs Fish directly and does not rewrite Bash syntax. Install Babelfish with `brew install babelfish`.

This is deliberately not a general Bash compatibility layer. Complex Bash syntax, inline environment assignments such as `NAME=value command`, and semantics Babelfish cannot translate should be written directly in Fish.

dsh-fish-shell README · Install：From this repository:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add "$PWD"
```

Restart the DSH host after installation. A restart is required because this is a server-side shell-executor plugin; client-plugin HMR does not reload it.

To remove it:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-fish-shell
```
dsh-fish-shell README · Compatibility：Tested against DSH `0.1.0-rc.6`. The plugin requires DSH's local bash-compatible shell executor (`runArgv` and `startArgv`).
